rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose everyday term for a grandmother, and also respectfully for an elderly woman when the context makes that appropriate.

example.english: My granny came for dim sum today.
example.jyutping: ngo5 po4 po4 gam1 jat6 lei4 zo2 jam2 caa4

rows.note: Use this instead of 婆婆 when you mean the paternal grandmother specifically.

example.english: My granny likes eating mangoes the most.
example.jyutping: ngo5 maa4 maa4 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 sik6 mong4 gwo2

rows.note: Use this instead of family-specific terms for an elderly woman when you are not asserting that she is your grandmother.

example.english: That granny exercises in the park every day.
example.traditional: 嗰個阿婆每日都喺公園做運動。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 aa3 po4 mui5 jat6 dou1 hai2 gung1 jyun4 zou6 wan6 dung6
